name: ThemePreview
description: Selectable cards that show a live miniature of each theme or preset: a radio group whose miniatures are drawn with the real tokens, by setting data-theme and data-preset on each miniature, so they stay accurate after a rebrand. A system card shows light and dark halves. Livewire only (D-003).

livewire.name: theme-preview
capabilities: wire:model binds the chosen option's value to each native radio, so .live sends it at once
Replaces the 2.x <livewire:theme-preview> theme builder tool, which is removed

props.name: options
props.description: The cards: { value, label, theme, preset, disabled }. theme is light, dark, high-contrast or system (light and dark halves); without it, a value that names a theme is used, else light. preset sets data-preset on the miniature.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen option's value. Livewire binds it with wire:model.

props.name: name
props.description: The radios' name. Defaults to the wire:model property, else a generated one.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the radio group. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __().

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { card: '…', frame: '…', label: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The radio group, named by label: a grid of cards.

parts.name: card
parts.description: One option, also .apui-theme-card: the frame and the label. Clicking anywhere on it checks its radio.

parts.name: frame
parts.description: The bordered 16:10 frame around the miniature; the checked card's frame takes the primary edge and ring.

parts.name: miniature
parts.description: The decorative page, aria-hidden, carrying data-theme and data-preset so the real tokens draw it. A system card has two, data-half start and end.

parts.name: sidebar
parts.description: The miniature's sidebar, with three lines.

parts.name: main
parts.description: The miniature's content: the header tile, then the tiles.

parts.name: tiles
parts.description: The two tiles under the header.

parts.name: tile
parts.description: A surface in the miniature; the header tile carries data-header.

parts.name: line
parts.description: A line of text in the miniature: data-accent for the primary color, data-strong for a figure.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The radio and the option's name, under the frame.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native radio, transparent over the box, carrying wire:model.

parts.name: text
parts.description: The option's name, the radio's accessible name.

keyboard.action: Moves to the checked card's radio, or the first one.
Moves to the next or previous card and checks it (platform behavior), following the text direction.

requirements: A role=radiogroup named by label, of native radios sharing one name, so the platform supplies roving focus and the arrow keys.
The miniature is decorative (aria-hidden); the label carries the name.
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight follow the text direction (native radios do in RTL); the System card's halves mirror too.
The checked card is shown by its frame's edge and ring and by the filled radio, not by color alone.
The focus ring shows on the frame while its radio has focus.
Miniatures are drawn with the real tokens, so they match the theme or preset they show.
